hash_format: SHA256; compact sorted-key ensure_ascii JSON plus LF per tick; NaN allowed
tick_retention: IPC only; bounded120s windows in summaries; no full per-tick disk exports
runtime_path: RunManager with InMemoryTimeseriesSink output-only append adapter; observes cover_shortfall and soc_floor_mwh; no control changes
study_path: native executor _expanded_spec/_probe/_run_mode; writer/cache output-only adapters; compact rows retained in memory and hashed, never exported

harness_guard_capture: allow_guard_failure=True captures native guard failures in the report; no guard evaluation is disabled, and parent requires record.status=PASS at R4
